statement: This document formally separates genuine real-time audio playback timing metrics from synthetic pipeline latency benchmark percentiles.

metrics.measurement_type: Real-time audio pacing and wall-clock scheduling drift
metrics.notes: Verified at 1.0x playback speed using Python asyncio chunk pacing; 96.36ms drift represents operating system timer jitter over 8 seconds of continuous streaming.

metrics.measurement_type: End-to-end and component latency percentiles (T0 to T4)
metrics.notes: Linear interpolation percentiles calculated over controlled 20-sample benchmark. Sub-second total latency confirms coaching delivery occurs before the conversational turn completes.
